description: This file registers and initializes the 'uicolor' plugin for CKEditor, including adding commands, buttons, dialog, and loading necessary scripts and styles.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds the 'uicolor' plugin with its configuration, commands, and dependencies.

methods.name: dialogCommand
methods.description: Creates a new dialog command for the 'uicolor' dialog.

methods.name: addButton
methods.description: Adds a button to the CKEditor UI for the 'uicolor' plugin.

methods.name: dialog.add
methods.description: Registers the 'uicolor' dialog with its path.

methods.name: scriptLoader.load
methods.description: Loads an external JavaScript resource necessary for the plugin.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Generates a URL for plugin resources.
